Maya Chen: FYI planning a condensed Meridian QBR — Tue 4/14 10am PT. Need: 6-slide exec narrative, 5-min demo, 1 commercial ask, and action log. Who can shepherd the deck?

Tom Jenkins: I can shepherd the deck + polish language. Will consolidate metrics and push a draft by Mon EOD.

Alexa Patel: I'll do account health + onboarding snapshot. Which cohorts to highlight? Pilot + top-10 ARR?

Maya Chen: Yes to pilot + top-10. Also surface 3 renewal-risk accounts with remediation bullets (Meridian, Harborline, Tactile). Keep each remediation to one line.

Noah Rossi: I'll own the demo. Planning a 5-min walkthrough with a fallback recorded clip. Need sandbox access; filed infra ticket #INF-4567.

Lila Gomez: I'll take notes and maintain the action log doc. Share the path when created.

QBR Bot: Template v2 is here: https://redwood.slides/qbr-template-v2 :white_check_mark: 

Tom Jenkins: Draft folder created: /QBRs/Meridian/2026-04-14. Added thesis slide + placeholders. @Alexa add funnel numbers and top-10 table.

Alexa Patel: Pulling numbers now. Quick callouts: TTV down 18% QoQ, seats/utilization below forecast by 12%, 3 open integration tickets (SUP-3321, INT-778, INF-4567).

Ben Sales: I'll prepare the commercial ask slide (6-mo discount vs. training credits). Can present that slide during the QBR. Sync with me for negotiation framing.

Maya Chen: Owners: Deck = Tom, Health = Alexa, Demo = Noah, Comm Ask = Ben, Notes = Lila. Please paste 2 risk bullets and remediation each into the kickoff doc by Mon EOD.

Tom Jenkins: Rehearsal set for Mon 11am PT (30m). Adding to calendar.

Lila Gomez: Action log template (pasting into kickoff doc):

```
Owner | Action | Due
Tom J | Deck polish + exec bullets | 2026-04-13 EOD
Alexa P | Health metrics + cohorts | 2026-04-13 EOD
Noah R | Demo prep + fallback recording | 2026-04-13 EOD
Ben S | Renewal proposal draft | 2026-04-13 12:00
Maya C | Exec alignment + runbook | 2026-04-13 EOD
Lila G | Notes + action tracker | 2026-04-14 EOD
```

Maya Chen: Thanks team. I'll ping execs post-rehearsal to confirm attendance. :sparkles:
